changes.evidence: At the end of Thunderbolts*, Valentina announces the team as the New Avengers and Yelena plays along. Nothing turns them back into the Thunderbolts afterwards: she is still a New Avenger in Spider-Man: Brand New Day ('the New Avengers are focusing on big potato stuff'), and the wiki lists New Avengers as her current group. The last stage, which goes back to 'The Thunderbolts' in Thunderbolts*, has nothing on screen behind it.

proposed: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
changes.evidence: In Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2, Taserface's mutiny turns Yondu's Ravager clan against him and makes Taserface captain. Yondu escapes with Rocket and Kraglin, kills the mutineers, destroys his own ship (the Eclector) and goes to help the Guardians fight Ego. The MCU wiki lists the Ravagers and Yondu's Ravager Clan as former groups and the Guardians of the Galaxy as his current group.
This is the Prowler (Aaron Davis) of Miles Morales's Into the Spider-Verse universe. His hero twin A:sv-aaron-davis-itsv is on Earth-1610, and a null Earth would wrongly put him on Earth-199999.
This is the Lizard of Spider-Man: The Animated Series (1994). His twin A:sv-curt-connors-1994 is on Earth-92131, and a null Earth would wrongly put him on Earth-199999.
This is the Lizard of The Spectacular Spider-Man. His twin A:sv-curt-connors-ssm is on Earth-26496, and a null Earth would wrongly put him on Earth-199999.
This is Eddie Brock/Venom of Spider-Man: The Animated Series (1994). His twin A:sv-eddie-brock-1994 is on Earth-92131, and a null Earth would wrongly put him on Earth-199999.

In The Spectacular Spider-Man season 2, episode 13 (episode 26 overall, 'Final Curtain'), Miles Warren blackmails Curt Connors over his Lizard past. Curt and Martha leave Empire State University and New York with Billy for the Florida Everglades. This is a real departure from ESU, and it is the season 2 step already on file.

After World War I, Ben is discharged from the Army and opens B. Reilly Investigations, with Janet Ruiz as his secretary. That is his firm through the whole 1933 story, where Cat Hardy and Silvermane hire him. Only in episode 8 does he make Janet a full partner and rename the firm Reilly & Ruiz Private Investigators. The Marvel Database lists the U.S. Army and B. Reilly Investigations as his former groups.

Jameson fires Eddie Brock from the Daily Bugle in season 1, first for the fake Spider-Man unmasking and again for smearing Spider-Man over Promethium X. Both firings come before the symbiote bonds with him (episode 9). He is not shown at the Bugle again until X-Men '97, which is not one of his titles on file. In every title on file (episodes 9 to 50) he is not on the Bugle staff. The Marvel Database lists the Daily Bugle as a former group.

This is the twin of A:sv-eddie-brock-1994. Jameson fires Eddie from the Bugle in season 1, before he becomes Venom in episode 9, so in every title on file (episodes 9 to 50) he is not on the Bugle staff.

His first step in story order is Spider-Man (1994) episode 43: in 1943 Steve Rogers volunteers for the Army's super-soldier experiment and becomes Captain America. So he is in the U.S. Army from that title, not from the later X-Men: TAS episode 73. The Six American Warriors stage should stay at the later Spider-Man (1994) step (episode 56). Check how the app resolves two stages that share a title before applying this.

owner_calls.question: Is the villain file 'Venom' the same person as Eddie Brock (A:sv-eddie-brock-sony), or the symbiote, a separate character? The two records disagree at the end: Venom is Deceased and Eddie is Active.
options: Keep as twins (Venom = the Eddie/symbiote pair)
Treat T:sv-venom-sony as the symbiote alone and unlink the twin
owner_calls.evidence: In Venom: The Last Dance the symbiote dies destroying the Codex and Eddie survives. The Venom record's last step follows the symbiote ('the symbiote dies'), while its other steps describe Eddie.
